atoms.name: neg
atoms.rule: - a is the negation of a.
atoms.plain: - a is the negation of a.
atoms.plain_zh: - a 是 a 的相反数。

atoms.name: logic_and
atoms.rule: a ⋀ b is true exactly when both a and b are true.
atoms.plain: a ⋀ b is true exactly when both a and b are true.
atoms.plain_zh: a ⋀ b 在 a 和 b 都为真时为真。

atoms.name: logic_or
atoms.rule: a ⋁ b is true exactly when a or b is true.
atoms.plain: a ⋁ b is true exactly when a or b is true.
atoms.plain_zh: a ⋁ b 在 a 或 b 为真时为真。

atoms.name: logic_not
atoms.rule: ¬ a is true exactly when a is false.
atoms.plain: ¬ a is true exactly when a is false.
atoms.plain_zh: ¬ a 在 a 为假时为真。

atoms.name: logic_implies
atoms.rule: a → b is false exactly when a is true and b is false.
atoms.plain: a → b is false exactly when a is true and b is false.
atoms.plain_zh: a → b 只在 a 为真而 b 为假时为假。

atoms.name: logic_xor
atoms.rule: a ≢ b is true exactly when a and b differ.
atoms.plain: a ≢ b is true exactly when a and b differ.
atoms.plain_zh: a ≢ b 在 a 和 b 真假不同时为真。

atoms.name: logic_equal
atoms.rule: a ⇔ b is true exactly when a and b have the same truth value.
atoms.plain: a ⇔ b is true exactly when a and b have the same truth value.
atoms.plain_zh: a ⇔ b 在 a 和 b 真假相同时为真。

domain.en: Values are the truth values true and false, plus integers that count recursive steps.
domain.zh: 取值是真和假两个真值，另有整数用来数递归步数。

settings.en: The preset that selects these atoms.
A recursive call repeats its step at most this many times; larger counts give NaN.
settings.zh: 递归最多重复这么多步，更大的次数得 NaN。

settings.en: The largest number of cases in a branch definition.
settings.zh: 分支定义最多的情形数。

why.en: These atoms are one example. Atoms are chosen by the user: any function with a rule can be registered and the same three composition forms grow operators from it.
why.zh: 这些原子只是一个例子。原子由用户自己选：任何写得出规则的函数都能注册，同样三种组合方式会从它长出新运算符。

operators.name: ★₁
operators.plain: Form a implies ¬a.
operators.plain_zh: 计算 a 蕴含 ¬a。

operators.name: ■₂
operators.definition: a ■₂ = { (a ★₁) ■₈ a, if a; a ★₁, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ★₁ to a, then apply ■₈ to the result and a; otherwise apply ★₁ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，先对 a 应用 ★₁，再对结果和 a 应用 ■₈；否则对 a 应用 ★₁。

operators.name: ♧₃
operators.definition: a ♧₃ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ♧₃ (b - 1)) ♢₁₁, if b > 0 and b <= 3; (a ♧₃ (b + 1)) ♢₁₁, if b < 0 and b >= - 3 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -3 to 3; other values give NaN): apply ♢₁₁ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果应用 ♢₁₁（b 取 -3 到 3，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ♤₄
operators.definition: a ♤₄ b = { (a ◇₅ b) ¬ }
operators.plain: Apply ◇₅ to a and b, then negate it.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₅，再对结果取反。

operators.name: ◇₅
operators.definition: a ◇₅ b = { a ≢ (a △₁₀ b) }
operators.plain: XOR a with a △₁₀ b.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 与 a △₁₀ b 做异或。

operators.name: ♢₆
operators.definition: a ♢₆ b = { (a ⇔ b) ≢ a }
operators.plain: Test whether a and b agree, then XOR it with a.
operators.plain_zh: 先判断 a 与 b 真假是否相同，再把结果与 a 做异或。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ◆₇
operators.definition: a ◆₇ b = { a ⋀ (a ⇔ b) }
operators.plain: AND a with a ⇔ b.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 与 a ⇔ b 做与运算。

operators.name: ■₈
operators.definition: a ■₈ b = { (a ⇔ b) ⋁ a }
operators.plain: Test whether a and b agree, then OR it with a.
operators.plain_zh: 先判断 a 与 b 真假是否相同，再把结果与 a 做或运算。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ○₉
operators.definition: a ○₉ b = { a ♢₆ (a ■₈ b) }
operators.plain: Apply ♢₆ to a and (a ■₈ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 a ■₈ b 应用 ♢₆。

operators.name: △₁₀
operators.definition: a △₁₀ b = { (a ⋁ b) ⋀ b }
operators.plain: OR a with b, then AND it with b.
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 与 b 做或运算，再把结果与 b 做与运算。

operators.name: ♢₁₁
operators.definition: a ♢₁₁ = { a ♢₆ (a ★₁) }
operators.plain: Apply ♢₆ to a and (a ★₁).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 a ★₁ 应用 ♢₆。

operators.name: ♢₁₂
operators.definition: a ♢₁₂ b = { b ⇔ (a → b) }
operators.plain: Test whether b and a → b agree.
operators.plain_zh: 判断 b 与 a → b 真假是否相同。

operators.name: ♢₁₃
operators.definition: a ♢₁₃ b = { (a ♢₁₂ b) ★₁ }
operators.plain: Apply ♢₁₂ to a and b, then apply ★₁ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♢₁₂，再对结果应用 ★₁。

operators.name: △₁₄
operators.definition: a △₁₄ b = { (a ◆₇ b) ★₁ }
operators.plain: Apply ◆₇ to a and b, then apply ★₁ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ◆₇，再对结果应用 ★₁。

operators.name: ♥₁₅
operators.definition: a ♥₁₅ b = { b △₁₀ (a → b) }
operators.plain: Apply △₁₀ to b and (a → b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 b 和 a → b 应用 △₁₀。

operators.name: ♦₁₆
operators.definition: a ♦₁₆ b = { (a ♤₄ b) ⋀ a }
operators.plain: Apply ♤₄ to a and b, then AND it with a.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♤₄，再把结果与 a 做与运算。

operators.name: ▽₁₇
operators.definition: a ▽₁₇ b = { (a △₁₀ b) ♢₁₂ a }
operators.plain: Apply △₁₀ to a and b, then apply ♢₁₂ to the result and a.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 △₁₀，再对结果和 a 应用 ♢₁₂。

operators.name: ▼₁₈
operators.definition: a ▼₁₈ b = { (a ◇₅ b) ○₉ a }
operators.plain: Apply ◇₅ to a and b, then apply ○₉ to the result and a.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₅，再对结果和 a 应用 ○₉。

operators.name: ♦₁₉
operators.definition: a ♦₁₉ b = { a ♢₁₃ (a ⇔ b), if a; a ⇔ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ♢₁₃ to a and (a ⇔ b); otherwise test whether a and b agree.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，对 a 和 a ⇔ b 应用 ♢₁₃；否则判断 a 与 b 真假是否相同。

operators.name: ♥₂₀
operators.definition: a ♥₂₀ b = { (a ♢₁₂ b) ♦₁₆ a, if a; a ♢₁₂ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ♢₁₂ to a and b, then apply ♦₁₆ to the result and a; otherwise compute a ♢₁₂ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，先对 a 和 b 应用 ♢₁₂，再对结果和 a 应用 ♦₁₆；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♢₁₂。

operators.name: □₂₁
operators.definition: a □₂₁ b = { b △₁₀ (a ⋀ b), if a; a ⋀ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply △₁₀ to b and (a ⋀ b); otherwise AND a with b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，对 b 和 a ⋀ b 应用 △₁₀；否则把 a 与 b 做与运算。

operators.name: ▼₂₂
operators.definition: a ▼₂₂ b = { (a → b) ≢ a, if a; a → b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, form a implies b, then XOR it with a; otherwise form a implies b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，先计算 a 蕴含 b，再把结果与 a 做异或；否则计算 a 蕴含 b。

operators.name: ♤₂₃
operators.definition: a ♤₂₃ b = { b ○₉ (a ◇₅ b), if a; a ◇₅ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ○₉ to b and (a ◇₅ b); otherwise compute a ◇₅ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，对 b 和 a ◇₅ b 应用 ○₉；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₅。

operators.name: ♣₂₄
operators.definition: a ♣₂₄ = { (a ■₂) ♢₆ a, if a; a ■₂, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ■₂ to a, then apply ♢₆ to the result and a; otherwise apply ■₂ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，先对 a 应用 ■₂，再对结果和 a 应用 ♢₆；否则对 a 应用 ■₂。

operators.name: ◇₂₅
operators.definition: a ◇₂₅ b = { (a ≢ b) ♦₁₆ b, if a; a ≢ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, XOR a with b, then apply ♦₁₆ to the result and b; otherwise XOR a with b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，先把 a 与 b 做异或，再对结果和 b 应用 ♦₁₆；否则把 a 与 b 做异或。

operators.name: ▲₂₆
operators.definition: a ▲₂₆ b = { b ♢₆ (a ■₈ b), if a; a ■₈ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ♢₆ to b and (a ■₈ b); otherwise compute a ■₈ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，对 b 和 a ■₈ b 应用 ♢₆；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ■₈。

operators.name: ♦₂₇
operators.definition: a ♦₂₇ b = { a ▽₁₇ (a ○₉ b), if a; a ○₉ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ▽₁₇ to a and (a ○₉ b); otherwise compute a ○₉ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，对 a 和 a ○₉ b 应用 ▽₁₇；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ○₉。

operators.name: ★₂₈
operators.definition: a ★₂₈ b = { b ▼₁₈ (a ♢₆ b), if a; a ♢₆ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ▼₁₈ to b and (a ♢₆ b); otherwise compute a ♢₆ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，对 b 和 a ♢₆ b 应用 ▼₁₈；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♢₆。

operators.name: ▼₂₉
operators.definition: a ▼₂₉ b = { a ○₉ (a ▼₂₂ b), if a; a ▼₂₂ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ○₉ to a and (a ▼₂₂ b); otherwise compute a ▼₂₂ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，对 a 和 a ▼₂₂ b 应用 ○₉；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ▼₂₂。

operators.name: ♠₃₀
operators.definition: a ♠₃₀ b = { (a ▼₂₂ b) ♣₂₄ }
operators.plain: Apply ▼₂₂ to a and b, then apply ♣₂₄ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ▼₂₂，再对结果应用 ♣₂₄。

operators.name: △₃₁
operators.definition: a △₃₁ b = { (a ♦₁₆ b) ▼₁₈ a, if a; a ♦₁₆ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ♦₁₆ to a and b, then apply ▼₁₈ to the result and a; otherwise compute a ♦₁₆ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，先对 a 和 b 应用 ♦₁₆，再对结果和 a 应用 ▼₁₈；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♦₁₆。

operators.name: ♠₃₂
operators.definition: a ♠₃₂ b = { (a ▼₂₂ b) ⋀ a }
operators.plain: Apply ▼₂₂ to a and b, then AND it with a.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ▼₂₂，再把结果与 a 做与运算。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ★₃₃
operators.definition: a ★₃₃ b = { a ○₉ (a ◇₂₅ b), if a; a ◇₂₅ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ○₉ to a and (a ◇₂₅ b); otherwise compute a ◇₂₅ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，对 a 和 a ◇₂₅ b 应用 ○₉；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₂₅。

operators.name: ◇₃₄
operators.definition: a ◇₃₄ b = { (a ⇔ b) □₂₁ b }
operators.plain: Test whether a and b agree, then apply □₂₁ to the result and b.
operators.plain_zh: 先判断 a 与 b 真假是否相同，再对结果和 b 应用 □₂₁。

operators.name: ♡₃₅
operators.definition: a ♡₃₅ b = { b ♤₄ (a ▼₂₂ b), if a; a ▼₂₂ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ♤₄ to b and (a ▼₂₂ b); otherwise compute a ▼₂₂ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，对 b 和 a ▼₂₂ b 应用 ♤₄；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ▼₂₂。

operators.name: ♠₃₆
operators.definition: a ♠₃₆ b = { (a ♦₂₇ b) △₁₀ b }
operators.plain: Apply ♦₂₇ to a and b, then apply △₁₀ to the result and b.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♦₂₇，再对结果和 b 应用 △₁₀。

operators.name: ♡₃₇
operators.definition: a ♡₃₇ b = { a ♢₁₃ (a ▼₂₂ b), if a; a ▼₂₂ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ♢₁₃ to a and (a ▼₂₂ b); otherwise compute a ▼₂₂ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，对 a 和 a ▼₂₂ b 应用 ♢₁₃；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ▼₂₂。

operators.name: ♧₃₈
operators.definition: a ♧₃₈ b = { (a ■₈ b) ★₃₃ b, if a; a ■₈ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ■₈ to a and b, then apply ★₃₃ to the result and b; otherwise compute a ■₈ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，先对 a 和 b 应用 ■₈，再对结果和 b 应用 ★₃₃；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ■₈。

operators.name: ★₃₉
operators.definition: a ★₃₉ b = { (a ♠₃₀ b) ★₃₃ b }
operators.plain: Apply ♠₃₀ to a and b, then apply ★₃₃ to the result and b.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♠₃₀，再对结果和 b 应用 ★₃₃。

operators.name: ♣₄₀
operators.definition: a ♣₄₀ b = { (a ▽₁₇ b) ♥₁₅ b, if a; a ▽₁₇ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ▽₁₇ to a and b, then apply ♥₁₅ to the result and b; otherwise compute a ▽₁₇ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，先对 a 和 b 应用 ▽₁₇，再对结果和 b 应用 ♥₁₅；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ▽₁₇。

operators.name: ♤₄₁
operators.definition: a ♤₄₁ b = { b ♢₆ (a ♢₁₃ b), if a; a ♢₁₃ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ♢₆ to b and (a ♢₁₃ b); otherwise compute a ♢₁₃ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，对 b 和 a ♢₁₃ b 应用 ♢₆；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♢₁₃。

operators.name: ♣₄₂
operators.definition: a ♣₄₂ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ♣₄₂ (b - 1)) ¬, if b > 0 and b <= 3; (a ♣₄₂ (b + 1)) ¬, if b < 0 and b >= - 3 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -3 to 3; other values give NaN): negate the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果取反（b 取 -3 到 3，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: △₄₃
operators.definition: a △₄₃ b = { a, if b == 0; (a △₄₃ (b - 1)) ■₂, if b > 0 and b <= 3; (a △₄₃ (b + 1)) ■₂, if b < 0 and b >= - 3 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -3 to 3; other values give NaN): apply ■₂ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果应用 ■₂（b 取 -3 到 3，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ☆₄₄
operators.definition: a ☆₄₄ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ☆₄₄ (b - 1)) ♣₂₄, if b > 0 and b <= 3; (a ☆₄₄ (b + 1)) ♣₂₄, if b < 0 and b >= - 3 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -3 to 3; other values give NaN): apply ♣₂₄ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果应用 ♣₂₄（b 取 -3 到 3，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ■₄₅
operators.definition: a ■₄₅ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ■₄₅ (b - 1)) ★₁, if b > 0 and b <= 3; (a ■₄₅ (b + 1)) ★₁, if b < 0 and b >= - 3 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -3 to 3; other values give NaN): apply ★₁ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果应用 ★₁（b 取 -3 到 3，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ●₄₆
operators.definition: a ●₄₆ b = { a ♤₄ (a △₄₃ b) }
operators.plain: Apply ♤₄ to a and (a △₄₃ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 a △₄₃ b 应用 ♤₄。

operators.name: ▼₄₇
operators.definition: a ▼₄₇ b = { a ▼₁₈ (a ●₄₆ b) }
operators.plain: Apply ▼₁₈ to a and (a ●₄₆ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 a ●₄₆ b 应用 ▼₁₈。

operators.name: ◇₄₈
operators.definition: a ◇₄₈ b = { a ♦₁₉ (a ☆₄₄ b) }
operators.plain: Apply ♦₁₉ to a and (a ☆₄₄ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 a ☆₄₄ b 应用 ♦₁₉。

operators.name: □₄₉
operators.definition: a □₄₉ b = { a ♠₃₂ (a ■₄₅ b) }
operators.plain: Apply ♠₃₂ to a and (a ■₄₅ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 a ■₄₅ b 应用 ♠₃₂。

operators.name: ♢₅₀
operators.definition: a ♢₅₀ b = { (a ☆₄₄ b) ¬ }
operators.plain: Apply ☆₄₄ to a and b, then negate it.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ☆₄₄，再对结果取反。

operators.name: ▼₅₁
operators.definition: a ▼₅₁ b = { a ♡₃₇ (a ◇₄₈ b) }
operators.plain: Apply ♡₃₇ to a and (a ◇₄₈ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 a ◇₄₈ b 应用 ♡₃₇。

operators.name: ▼₅₂
operators.definition: a ▼₅₂ b = { (a ◇₄₈ b) ⋁ a }
operators.plain: Apply ◇₄₈ to a and b, then OR it with a.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₄₈，再把结果与 a 做或运算。

operators.name: ▲₅₃
operators.definition: a ▲₅₃ b = { (a △₄₃ b) ♤₄₁ a }
operators.plain: Apply △₄₃ to a and b, then apply ♤₄₁ to the result and a.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 △₄₃，再对结果和 a 应用 ♤₄₁。

operators.name: ■₅₄
operators.definition: a ■₅₄ b = { (a ▼₄₇ b) ■₂ }
operators.plain: Apply ▼₄₇ to a and b, then apply ■₂ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ▼₄₇，再对结果应用 ■₂。

operators.name: ◆₅₅
operators.definition: a ◆₅₅ b = { a ♥₁₅ (a ♧₃ b) }
operators.plain: Apply ♥₁₅ to a and (a ♧₃ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 a ♧₃ b 应用 ♥₁₅。

operators.name: ■₅₆
operators.definition: a ■₅₆ b = { a ♧₃₈ (a ▼₅₁ b) }
operators.plain: Apply ♧₃₈ to a and (a ▼₅₁ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 a ▼₅₁ b 应用 ♧₃₈。

operators.name: ●₅₇
operators.definition: a ●₅₇ b = { a ♦₂₇ (a ♣₄₂ b) }
operators.plain: Apply ♦₂₇ to a and (a ♣₄₂ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 a ♣₄₂ b 应用 ♦₂₇。

operators.name: ♥₅₈
operators.definition: a ♥₅₈ b = { a ▲₂₆ (a ♢₅₀ b) }
operators.plain: Apply ▲₂₆ to a and (a ♢₅₀ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 a ♢₅₀ b 应用 ▲₂₆。

operators.name: ▲₅₉
operators.definition: a ▲₅₉ b = { (a ●₄₆ b) ♡₃₅ a }
operators.plain: Apply ●₄₆ to a and b, then apply ♡₃₅ to the result and a.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ●₄₆，再对结果和 a 应用 ♡₃₅。

operators.name: ▼₆₀
operators.definition: a ▼₆₀ b = { (a △₄₃ b) ■₅₆ b }
operators.plain: Apply △₄₃ to a and b, then apply ■₅₆ to the result and b.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 △₄₃，再对结果和 b 应用 ■₅₆。

operators.name: ★₆₁
operators.definition: a ★₆₁ b = { a ♢₁₃ (a ●₅₇ b), if a; a ●₅₇ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ♢₁₃ to a and (a ●₅₇ b); otherwise compute a ●₅₇ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，对 a 和 a ●₅₇ b 应用 ♢₁₃；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ●₅₇。

operators.name: ☆₆₂
operators.definition: a ☆₆₂ b = { (a ●₅₇ b) → a, if a; a ●₅₇ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ●₅₇ to a and b, then form it implies a; otherwise compute a ●₅₇ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，先对 a 和 b 应用 ●₅₇，再计算结果蕴含 a；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ●₅₇。

operators.name: ☆₆₃
operators.definition: a ☆₆₃ b = { (a ♧₃ b) ●₅₇ b, if a; a ♧₃ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ♧₃ to a and b, then apply ●₅₇ to the result and b; otherwise compute a ♧₃ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，先对 a 和 b 应用 ♧₃，再对结果和 b 应用 ●₅₇；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♧₃。

operators.name: ●₆₄
operators.definition: a ●₆₄ b = { a ◆₇ (a ■₅₄ b), if a; a ■₅₄ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ◆₇ to a and (a ■₅₄ b); otherwise compute a ■₅₄ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，对 a 和 a ■₅₄ b 应用 ◆₇；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ■₅₄。

operators.name: ●₆₅
operators.definition: a ●₆₅ b = { (a ☆₆₃ b) ■₅₆ b, if a; a ☆₆₃ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ☆₆₃ to a and b, then apply ■₅₆ to the result and b; otherwise compute a ☆₆₃ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，先对 a 和 b 应用 ☆₆₃，再对结果和 b 应用 ■₅₆；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ☆₆₃。

operators.name: ♠₆₆
operators.definition: a ♠₆₆ b = { (a ●₆₄ b) ◆₅₅ b, if a; a ●₆₄ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ●₆₄ to a and b, then apply ◆₅₅ to the result and b; otherwise compute a ●₆₄ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，先对 a 和 b 应用 ●₆₄，再对结果和 b 应用 ◆₅₅；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ●₆₄。

operators.name: ♣₆₇
operators.definition: a ♣₆₇ b = { (a ■₄₅ b) ●₆₄ b, if a; a ■₄₅ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ■₄₅ to a and b, then apply ●₆₄ to the result and b; otherwise compute a ■₄₅ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，先对 a 和 b 应用 ■₄₅，再对结果和 b 应用 ●₆₄；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ■₄₅。

operators.name: ●₆₈
operators.definition: a ●₆₈ b = { (a ◇₄₈ b) ■₅₆ b, if a; a ◇₄₈ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ◇₄₈ to a and b, then apply ■₅₆ to the result and b; otherwise compute a ◇₄₈ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，先对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₄₈，再对结果和 b 应用 ■₅₆；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₄₈。

operators.name: ■₆₉
operators.definition: a ■₆₉ b = { (a ♥₅₈ b) ♧₃₈ a, if a; a ♥₅₈ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ♥₅₈ to a and b, then apply ♧₃₈ to the result and a; otherwise compute a ♥₅₈ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，先对 a 和 b 应用 ♥₅₈，再对结果和 a 应用 ♧₃₈；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♥₅₈。

operators.name: ■₇₀
operators.definition: a ■₇₀ b = { a ★₂₈ (a ♢₅₀ b), if a; a ♢₅₀ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ★₂₈ to a and (a ♢₅₀ b); otherwise compute a ♢₅₀ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，对 a 和 a ♢₅₀ b 应用 ★₂₈；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♢₅₀。

operators.name: ♥₇₁
operators.definition: a ♥₇₁ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ♥₇₁ (b - 1)) ▼₆₀ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 3; (a ♥₇₁ (b + 1)) ▼₆₀ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 3 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -3 to 3; other values give NaN): apply ▼₆₀ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 ▼₆₀（b 取 -3 到 3，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: □₇₂
operators.definition: a □₇₂ b = { a, if b == 0; (a □₇₂ (b - 1)) ■₅₄ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 3; (a □₇₂ (b + 1)) ■₅₄ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 3 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -3 to 3; other values give NaN): apply ■₅₄ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 ■₅₄（b 取 -3 到 3，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ★₇₃
operators.definition: a ★₇₃ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ★₇₃ (b - 1)) ●₅₇ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 3; (a ★₇₃ (b + 1)) ●₅₇ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 3 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -3 to 3; other values give NaN): apply ●₅₇ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 ●₅₇（b 取 -3 到 3，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ○₇₄
operators.definition: a ○₇₄ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ○₇₄ (b - 1)) ☆₆₃ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 3; (a ○₇₄ (b + 1)) ☆₆₃ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 3 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -3 to 3; other values give NaN): apply ☆₆₃ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 ☆₆₃（b 取 -3 到 3，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ▲₇₅
operators.definition: a ▲₇₅ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ▲₇₅ (b - 1)) ■₆₉ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 3; (a ▲₇₅ (b + 1)) ■₆₉ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 3 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -3 to 3; other values give NaN): apply ■₆₉ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 ■₆₉（b 取 -3 到 3，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ★₇₆
operators.definition: a ★₇₆ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ★₇₆ (b - 1)) ●₄₆ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 3; (a ★₇₆ (b + 1)) ●₄₆ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 3 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -3 to 3; other values give NaN): apply ●₄₆ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 ●₄₆（b 取 -3 到 3，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: □₇₇
operators.definition: a □₇₇ b = { a, if b == 0; (a □₇₇ (b - 1)) □₄₉ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 3; (a □₇₇ (b + 1)) □₄₉ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 3 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -3 to 3; other values give NaN): apply □₄₉ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 □₄₉（b 取 -3 到 3，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ▲₇₈
operators.definition: a ▲₇₈ b = { (a ★₇₆ b) ●₆₈ b }
operators.plain: Apply ★₇₆ to a and b, then apply ●₆₈ to the result and b.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ★₇₆，再对结果和 b 应用 ●₆₈。

operators.name: △₇₉
operators.definition: a △₇₉ b = { a ≢ (a □₇₂ b) }
operators.plain: XOR a with a □₇₂ b.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 与 a □₇₂ b 做异或。

operators.name: ○₈₀
operators.definition: a ○₈₀ b = { (a ♥₇₁ b) ☆₆₂ b }
operators.plain: Apply ♥₇₁ to a and b, then apply ☆₆₂ to the result and b.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♥₇₁，再对结果和 b 应用 ☆₆₂。

operators.name: ■₈₁
operators.definition: a ■₈₁ b = { (a ♥₇₁ b) ★₃₉ a }
operators.plain: Apply ♥₇₁ to a and b, then apply ★₃₉ to the result and a.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♥₇₁，再对结果和 a 应用 ★₃₉。

operators.name: □₈₂
operators.definition: a □₈₂ b = { (a △₇₉ b) ♤₄ a }
operators.plain: Apply △₇₉ to a and b, then apply ♤₄ to the result and a.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 △₇₉，再对结果和 a 应用 ♤₄。

operators.name: ■₈₃
operators.definition: a ■₈₃ b = { a ♠₃₀ (a ▲₇₈ b) }
operators.plain: Apply ♠₃₀ to a and (a ▲₇₈ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 a ▲₇₈ b 应用 ♠₃₀。

operators.name: ◇₈₄
operators.definition: a ◇₈₄ b = { (a ■₈₁ b) ☆₆₂ b }
operators.plain: Apply ■₈₁ to a and b, then apply ☆₆₂ to the result and b.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ■₈₁，再对结果和 b 应用 ☆₆₂。

operators.name: ♥₈₅
operators.definition: a ♥₈₅ b = { a ♥₁₅ (a ■₈₁ b) }
operators.plain: Apply ♥₁₅ to a and (a ■₈₁ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 a ■₈₁ b 应用 ♥₁₅。

operators.name: ○₈₆
operators.definition: a ○₈₆ b = { (a ■₈₁ b) ♡₃₅ a }
operators.plain: Apply ■₈₁ to a and b, then apply ♡₃₅ to the result and a.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ■₈₁，再对结果和 a 应用 ♡₃₅。

operators.name: ▲₈₇
operators.definition: a ▲₈₇ b = { (a △₇₉ b) ▼₄₇ b }
operators.plain: Apply △₇₉ to a and b, then apply ▼₄₇ to the result and b.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 △₇₉，再对结果和 b 应用 ▼₄₇。

operators.name: ◆₈₈
operators.definition: a ◆₈₈ b = { a ■₈ (a △₇₉ b) }
operators.plain: Apply ■₈ to a and (a △₇₉ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 a △₇₉ b 应用 ■₈。

operators.name: ▼₈₉
operators.definition: a ▼₈₉ b = { (a ♥₇₁ b) ○₈₀ b, if a; a ♥₇₁ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ♥₇₁ to a and b, then apply ○₈₀ to the result and b; otherwise compute a ♥₇₁ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，先对 a 和 b 应用 ♥₇₁，再对结果和 b 应用 ○₈₀；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♥₇₁。

operators.name: ○₉₀
operators.definition: a ○₉₀ b = { (a ★₇₃ b) ■₅₄ b, if a; a ★₇₃ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ★₇₃ to a and b, then apply ■₅₄ to the result and b; otherwise compute a ★₇₃ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，先对 a 和 b 应用 ★₇₃，再对结果和 b 应用 ■₅₄；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ★₇₃。

operators.name: ♣₉₁
operators.definition: a ♣₉₁ b = { (a ◆₈₈ b) ■₈₃ b, if a; a ◆₈₈ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ◆₈₈ to a and b, then apply ■₈₃ to the result and b; otherwise compute a ◆₈₈ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，先对 a 和 b 应用 ◆₈₈，再对结果和 b 应用 ■₈₃；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ◆₈₈。

operators.name: ▼₉₂
operators.definition: a ▼₉₂ b = { (a ▲₈₇ b) ○₈₆ b, if a; a ▲₈₇ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ▲₈₇ to a and b, then apply ○₈₆ to the result and b; otherwise compute a ▲₈₇ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，先对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₈₇，再对结果和 b 应用 ○₈₆；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₈₇。

operators.name: ▲₉₃
operators.definition: a ▲₉₃ b = { (a ▲₈₇ b) ◇₈₄ b, if a; a ▲₈₇ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ▲₈₇ to a and b, then apply ◇₈₄ to the result and b; otherwise compute a ▲₈₇ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，先对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₈₇，再对结果和 b 应用 ◇₈₄；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₈₇。

operators.name: ●₉₄
operators.definition: a ●₉₄ b = { (a ▲₉₃ b) ◇₂₅ a, if a; a ▲₉₃ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ▲₉₃ to a and b, then apply ◇₂₅ to the result and a; otherwise compute a ▲₉₃ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，先对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₉₃，再对结果和 a 应用 ◇₂₅；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₉₃。

operators.name: ○₉₅
operators.definition: a ○₉₅ b = { (a ○₈₆ b) ♢₅₀ b, if a; a ○₈₆ b, else }
operators.plain: If a is true, apply ○₈₆ to a and b, then apply ♢₅₀ to the result and b; otherwise compute a ○₈₆ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 为真，先对 a 和 b 应用 ○₈₆，再对结果和 b 应用 ♢₅₀；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ○₈₆。
